findings.persistent_private_learners: Repeated local subgraph training; client parameters carried through local/global blends. Bias encoders remain local.
findings.shared_representation_learning: Pooling and predictive MLP parameters are averaged each round, then client-specific similarity blends shared and previous local parameters.
findings.dependent_graph_supervision: Client user-item subgraphs; pair preference contrastive learning with positive and negative pairs.
findings.private_learning_credit: No outer-query loss differentiated through a private optimizer map in selected method.
findings.endpoint_rule: No current outer positive/negative endpoint-union label eligibility in selected method.
findings.common_core: Multiple personalized parameter copies with global aggregate; no single simultaneously shared representation block in all private update maps specified.
findings.serving: Client-specific recommendation; fixed served mean-logit ensemble not specified.
findings.sharing_failure: Different client-subgraph sizes/connectivity and popularity distributions. Not established for current common support/core.
findings.successor: No supported native successor; structural descriptor from identical common support has no cross-member distinction.

sources.title: Personalized Federated Knowledge Graph Embedding with Client-Wise Relation Graph
sources.figure_scope: Caption text within selected sections only; algorithm pseudocode semantically inspected.

findings.persistent_private_learners: Local entity/relation embedding clients trained repeatedly; entities initialize from personalized supplementary embedding each round and relations carry prior state.
findings.shared_representation_learning: Client affinity graph mixes aligned entity embeddings from prior local learners; residual local blend and proximity penalty preserve personalized knowledge.
findings.dependent_graph_supervision: Partly overlapping KGs and local triple/self-adversarial negative supervision.
findings.private_learning_credit: No outer loss or differentiation through client updates in Algorithm1; recomputation of affinity from embeddings is not a meta-gradient.
findings.endpoint_rule: No current outer positive/negative endpoint-union label eligibility in selected method.
findings.common_core: Personalized supplementary embeddings and local copies rather than one differentiated shared core.
findings.serving: Each client entity/relation embedding returned; fixed served mean ensemble not specified.
findings.sharing_failure: Semantic disparities and local/global objective mismatch across partly overlapping KGs. Not established for current common support/core.
findings.successor: No supported native successor; personalized embedding exchange would alter state/aggregation and needs separate controls.
